protocol: VP-1.0 (Tier B: thresholds and key dates only)
note: Text is 151K characters; the reference covers Articles 1-32 plus the OJ header, the signature block and the footnotes (legislative history). The 86 recitals were not scanned for items. Key dates = legislative steps stated in the text, adoption, publication, entry into force, application and transposition dates, cohort cut-offs, and calendar deadlines stated in operative articles. Relative procedural periods (Art. 10(1) 'at least six months before' use) are not reference items; annotated items covering them are judged on their merits. The Art. 15(4) two-year term of the press publishers' right is listed as a threshold (benefit_duration); an event coding it is also accepted as a match.

items.quote: Position of the European Parliament of 26 March 2019
decision of the Council of 15 April 2019
This Directive shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.
Member States shall bring into force the laws, regulations and administrative provisions necessary to comply with this Directive by 7 June 2021.
This Directive shall apply in respect of all works and other subject matter that are protected by national law in the field of copyright on or after 7 June 2021.
items.value: application in time: works protected on or after 2021-06-07; acts concluded and rights acquired before that date unaffected

items.quote: Agreements for the licence or transfer of rights of authors and performers shall be subject to the transparency obligation set out in Article 19 as from 7 June 2022.
items.value: Art. 19 transparency obligation applies to licence/transfer agreements from 2022-06-07

items.quote: Paragraph 1 shall not apply to press publications first published before 6 June 2019.
items.value: press publishers' right applies only to press publications first published on or after 2019-06-06 (cohort cut-off)

items.quote: Member States shall notify the Commission of the body or mediators referred to in the first paragraph no later than 7 June 2021.
items.value: deadline 2021-06-07 for notifying the VOD negotiation body or mediators

items.quote: the Commission shall, by 10 April 2021, submit to the European Parliament and to the Council a report on the use in the Union of the licensing mechanisms
items.value: Commission report on extended collective licensing due 2021-04-10

items.quote: As of 6 June 2019 the Commission, in cooperation with the Member States, shall organise stakeholder dialogues
items.value: Commission stakeholder dialogues on Art. 17 from 2019-06-06

items.quote: The Commission shall, by 7 June 2024, assess the impact of the specific liability regime set out in Article 17
items.value: Commission assessment of the Art. 17(6) regime due 2024-06-07

items.quote: No sooner than 7 June 2026, the Commission shall carry out a review of this Directive
items.value: Commission review of the Directive no sooner than 2026-06-07

items.quote: the services of which have been available to the public in the Union for less than three years
items.value: service age < 3 years (jointly with turnover < EUR 10m) -> lighter OCSSP liability conditions

items.quote: which have an annual turnover below EUR 10 million, calculated in accordance with Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC
items.value: annual turnover < EUR 10 million (jointly with < 3 years) -> lighter OCSSP liability conditions

items.quote: Where the average number of monthly unique visitors of such service providers exceeds 5 million, calculated on the basis of the previous calendar year
items.value: average monthly unique visitors > 5 million (previous calendar year) -> new small OCSSPs must also make best efforts to prevent re-uploads

items.quote: The rights provided for in paragraph 1 shall expire two years after the press publication is published. That term shall be calculated from 1 January of the year following the date on which that press publication is published.
items.value: press publishers' right lasts 2 years, counted from 1 January of the year after publication (benefit_duration)
